title: Optimizing Click-Through in Online Rankings with Endogenous Search Refinement
authors: Babur De los Santos; Sergei Koulayev
eligible_reason: Structural model of consumer search and click on a hotel comparison platform; optimal ranking simulations. No DiD.
design_notes: mlik.m loads data, sols_fb.m sets the specification, model/loglik_0403.m is the search-and-choice likelihood, sims2/master.m runs ranking simulations.
data_files_note: readme.txt: NDA did not allow providing the underlying data; enclosed .mat files contain simulated data.
data_provenance_note: Simulated data replacing the NDA clickstream data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract from data/frame/mksc.jsonl read. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
